s: MLPs are publicly traded limited partnerships, so investors can easily buy and sell units on a stock exchange. As an MLP, Enterprise is a pass-through entity, meaning its profits, losses, deductions, and credits are passed on to investors. For a company to operate as an MLP, the IRS requires it to earn 90% of its income from qualifying sources, including exploration, production, and transportation of natural resources.

s: Enterprise Products Company, based in Houston, Texas, is a service company in the natural gas liquids and base chemical industry. The company was founded as Enterprise Service Company in 1968, and changed its name in 1971. Enterprise provides a full range of storage, processing and distribution services to refineries, chemical companies and natural gas users and producers.
